summary: An elected member leaves the daily business of the office to a young hire.
realLife: Richard Kleberg put Lyndon Johnson on his staff and gave him responsibility for running the congressional office.
inGame: needs: a member's delegation of office decisions to a named staffer.

turns.what: The member calls for the day's constituent letters and signs each reply.
turns.pulledBy: The member has returned to the district office and wants direct contact.
turns.writesBack: Replies carry the member's own review.

turns.what: The secretary handles routine cases and puts disputed ones on the member's desk.
turns.pulledBy: The member has reserved decisions involving contested claims.
turns.writesBack: The case file names who handled each referral.
